description:
Address reviewer jfayad's ownership/privacy comment on PR #876:
https://github.com/www-zaq-ai/zaq/pull/876#issuecomment-6525908396

Objective: make StreamEvents the sole request-local attachment-selection owner. Retain AttachDocuments authorization and pure mutation rules; remove redundant RequestEffects/Jido-state/mailbox machinery after parity is proven.

Related work: completed zaq-ic9.14 (original selection implementation), zaq-juu (Channels delivery). Do not reopen their completed work or duplicate unrelated StreamEvents coverage tasks. Baseline inspected: 32a2c1edb on feat/channel-files.

Authorization: user requested creation of this implementation epic on 2026-10-31. This authorizes tracking only, not code changes, changed test expectations, commits/pushes, or reviewer replies. The previous no-Beadwork restriction is superseded for this epic creation. Privacy/test-behavior approval remains an explicit first-child gate.

Invariants: preserve add/remove/replace semantics, identity deduplication, whole-batch authorization, explicit bypass only, no early delivery or source deletion, declaration-order application, invocation replay suppression, request isolation, steering, failure/cancellation discard, successful-final-only attachments, current-source authorization at delivery, existing Executor/Outgoing/Channels boundaries and public ToolStep privacy. Incoming files are never auto-selected. Configured-agent scope remains as accepted in zaq-ic9.14; do not re-enable the excluded legacy Pipeline path.

Action reuse assessment: extend AttachDocuments and existing GetDocument validated Jido.Exec path, Record provenance/authorization, OpaqueAliases and StreamEvents completion handling. StreamEvents owns request-local accumulation; the Action owns pure selection rules. Reuse ToolStep.project for public display and existing Materialization/NodeRouter/Mailer/Jido delivery. No new Action, tool key, state store or request-effect framework. Alias expansion is local-only transport adaptation, not a separate business operation. Revalidate scope/lifetime and raw-versus-aliased exposure before implementation.

Implementation sequence: privacy/contract gate -> validated Action result -> stream accumulation -> remove RequestEffects -> integration/docs/review -> post-review coverage/final validation. Linear DAG, no diamonds. Children specify tests before implementation, contracts, affected files, reuse decisions and acceptance criteria.

Non-goals: SMTP resolver fixes, resource budgets (#875), adapter error contract (#893), new UI or new checkpoint architecture. Reuse existing approved Mattermost/email integration journeys and external stubs; no new feature E2E scope is presumed. If substantial new E2E or changed visible behavior becomes necessary, follow the existing human UX approval gate.

Stop/replan if alias lifetime cannot support consumption, ordering/authorization changes, metadata reaches a new audience, tests require unapproved behavioral changes, or another parallel state mechanism is proposed. Do not close until every child is complete and final human approval is recorded. Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/services/agent.md, docs/testing-approach.md and docs/documentation.md.

## Tracked implementation sequence
1. zaq-aa6.1: Approve privacy contract and existing-test changes
2. zaq-aa6.2: Prepare validated attachment instruction results and alias expansion
3. zaq-aa6.3: Move attachment accumulation into StreamEvents
4. zaq-aa6.4: Remove RequestEffects and restore ordinary Factory event handling
5. zaq-aa6.5: Validate channel journeys, update documentation and obtain review
6. zaq-aa6.6: Complete post-review coverage and final validation
